content.text: {"lines": [{"name": "E1", "score": 7, "reason": "The cold open punches in on the face and the title lands inside two seconds."}, {"name": "E2", "score": 6, "reason": "The card and the photo match their beats; the wall repeats the hook's pictures."}, {"name": "E3", "score": 8, "reason": "Full, PIP and off alternate every beat or two; no mode runs long."}, {"name": "E4", "score": 7, "reason": "Something changes on screen on every beat."}, {"name": "E5", "score": 8, "reason": "Two to four words a page, the keyword boxed, nothing under the PIP."}, {"name": "E6", "score": 6, "reason": "The chin sits high in the circle on three strip frames."}, {"name": "E7", "score": 7, "reason": "The bed sits 10 dB under the voice with hits on the stamp and the finale."}, {"name": "E8", "score": 5, "reason": "The finale word repeats the title instead of paying the question off."}, {"name": "E9", "score": 9, "reason": "Every picture is credited and the generated ones are disclosed."}, {"name": "E10", "score": 9, "reason": "Nothing on screen would embarrass the presenter."}], "overall": 7, "fix_notes": ["Lower the PIP window so the chin sits at 82 % of the circle.", "Change the finale word to answer the hook's question.", "Give the wall its own pictures instead of the hook's three."]}
